SOP-07 - purpose of the main steps (QA note)
Prepared for the ISO 9001 surveillance audit.
Draining residual product into the recovery drum reduces waste and recovers product:
the recovery drums are reprocessed into primers.
The first acetone rinse removes the product film before the next batch.
